title: Balanced two-way factorial ANOVA with interaction-aware simple-effects reporting
source_relation: adapted: fixed reporting rule, simple effects against the full-model MSE, closed-form oracle
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents report main effects in the presence of a crossover interaction, or compute simple effects from separate per-site ANOVAs (different error term and df) instead of the full-model residual mean square, or fail to stop on unbalanced data where the table is not uniquely defined.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Pure factorial-design reasoning with an explicit reporting rule; nothing depends on a package, version or documentation fact beyond base R.
mcp_relevance.information_need: How simple effects are tested against the pooled full-model error term.
mcp_relevance.obtainable_without_mcp: yes: textbook formulas and installed stats help
alternative_solution_paths: lm + anova for the table, then per-site SS from cell means with the full MSE
nested model comparison score ~ site vs score ~ site + site:treatment, split by site

calibration_risks.ceiling: moderate-high: a standard textbook procedure with explicit instructions

pinned_evidence.oracle: balanced-design closed-form sums of squares; cross-checked at load against anova(lm) and the nested-model identity SS(simple effects) = SS(A) + SS(AB)
